[Section] Experiments ::: Experimental Settings ::: Pre-trained Embedding
[source_id=48] We only use unigram feature so we only trained character embeddings. Our pre-trained embedding are pre-trained on Chinese Wikipedia corpus by word2vec BIBREF29 toolkit. The corpus used for pre-trained embedding is all transferred to simplified Chinese and not segmented. On closed test, we use embeddings initialized randomly.
